svg.title: PitchFork
svg.desc: PitchFork: rebuilds the live order book for every stock from a full day of raw NASDAQ ITCH 5.0 data, then tests trading signals on it. 8.9 million messages a second on one laptop core. A 46 KB WebAssembly build runs in the browser. The drawing shows one 36-byte Add Order message, field by field, turning into a new level in the AAPL book. Built with C++17, WebAssembly and Linux.
